entities.name: DSLAM
entities.description: Network access equipment supporting xDSL lines. Has production status (open/closed). Contains shelves, cards, ports.

entities.name: MSAN
entities.description: Multi-service access node supporting VDSL2, GPON. Variant of DSLAM with extended service support.

entities.name: CARD
entities.description: Physical card installed in a DSLAM/MSAN chassis. Can be open or closed for production. Contains ports.

entities.name: PORT
entities.description: Physical connection point on a card. Has occupation status, production status, attributable flag.

entities.name: SHELF
entities.description: Logical shelf grouping cards within a DSLAM chassis.

entities.name: NODE
entities.description: Geographic network concentration point. Can be NRA (copper) or NRO (fiber). Contains DSLAMs and distributors.

entities.name: EPC
entities.description: Customer service record. References the client ND and service versions. Entry point for provisioning commands.

entities.name: MRT
entities.description: Technical resource link between customer (EPC) and physical DSLAM port. Key routing object.

entities.name: CCL
entities.description: Logical resource (VLAN/VC) binding DSLAM to NIP/BAS. Has VC counters and production status. Critical for GE/CEV offers.

entities.name: VLAN
entities.description: Virtual LAN identifier used for service routing. Managed via CCL resources.

entities.name: VP_VC
entities.description: ATM VP/VC resource assigned on DSLAM port for ADSL/VDSL services.

entities.name: MAKING_FILE
entities.description: Provisioning order file. Contains business process type (CL/SAV/DLM/AVP/RES). Central orchestration object.

entities.name: NIP
entities.description: IP network node (BAS/BRAS/BNG) aggregating DSLAM traffic via CCL/VC resources.

entities.name: OPERATOR
entities.description: Telecom operator (Orange, resellers). Controls service provisioning.

entities.name: REGLETTE
entities.db_table: implicit (referenced in FR docs and UMI-EPC messages)
entities.description: Physical distribution frame strip. Referenced in MRT Access DSLAM for copper line termination.

entities.name: REPARTITEUR
entities.description: Main Distribution Frame. Physical junction between subscriber copper lines and DSLAM.

entities.name: MUTATION
entities.description: Physical link mutation operation. Moves service between DSLAMs or nodes.

entities.name: DISTRIBUTOR
entities.description: Distribution element within a node. Connected to DSLAMs.

entities.name: TSF
entities.description: Technical service function binding. Defines which services can be provisioned on a DSLAM port.

entities.name: DR_ZONE
entities.description: Regional zone grouping network nodes. Used for geographic routing and assignment.

entities.name: BRASIL
entities.description: BRASIL application - telecom resource management system

entities.name: ORCHESTRA
entities.description: Orchestra - network element repository (référentiel NE)

entities.name: SEBA
entities.description: SEBA - service management application

entities.name: E_BASILIQ
entities.description: E-Basiliq - order processing system via MQ

entities.name: IPON
entities.description: IPON - IP/ON service management

entities.name: SCA
entities.description: SCA - service catalog application

entities.name: ADELIA
entities.description: ADELIA - provisioning automation

entities.name: UMI_EPC
entities.description: UMI-EPC connector - EPC movement processor

entities.name: UMI_DICO
entities.description: UMI-DICO connector - dictionary synchronization

entities.name: CONNECTOR_CL
entities.description: ConnectorCL - provisioning request processor

entities.name: CONNECTOR_VLAN
entities.description: ConnectorCreationVLAN - VLAN creation handler

entities.name: SOLICITATION_DLM
entities.description: SollicitationDLM - DLM provisioning trigger

entities.name: SOLICITATION_FTTH
entities.description: SollicitationFTTH - FTTH provisioning trigger

entities.name: RABBITMQ
entities.description: RabbitMQ - message queue for async processing

entities.name: POSTGRESQL
entities.description: PostgreSQL - BRASIL database backend
